scope: Executable C-shim reference and finite regression only; no complete kernel proof, formal refinement, real ISA execution, or hardware correspondence.

references.title: RISC-V scalar floating-point canonical NaN arithmetic

configuration.architecture: LP64 host, little-endian checked by test driver
configuration.arm: Armv8-style FPCR.DN=0, FZ=0, RMode=RNE; alternate NaN handling features disabled
configuration.exceptions: flags/traps/FPSR/fflags are unobserved; runtime does not claim their architectural behavior

layout.runtime: By-value structs with uint32_t lane arrays (NEON4, half2, RVV32) and signed int32 arrays after memcpy reinterpretation; mask arrays contain Boolean values. No pointer-backed shared vector object.
layout.formal: Formal candidate uses distinct fixed scalar-field structs and C-call contracts; this runtime is not linked into QCP.
layout.relationship: Lane-index correspondence is intended, not formally proved; no ABI identity claim. Real impl sources are linked unchanged into the runtime.

formal_multiplication_boundary.source: External QCP Rocq/SeparationLogic/FloatLib.v: fp32_mul, fp32_binary_nan, fp32_nan
formal_multiplication_boundary.definition: Flocq Bmult mode_NE with fp32_binary_nan; every formal arithmetic NaN has sign=false and payload=1.
formal_multiplication_boundary.runtime_difference: Arm runtime propagates selected quieted operand NaN; RVV runtime emits canonical quiet NaN. Neither is represented as exact bit equality to the fixed formal NaN.
formal_multiplication_boundary.observation_argument: Kernel selects its branch using the sign bit of the ORIGINAL input before selection. It never reinterprets multiplication output. Multiplication NaN payload/sign therefore reaches only final outputs, where all NaNs are related. Positive-sign input (including positive sNaN) bypasses multiplication via bit selection and preserves its input bits.
formal_multiplication_boundary.status: Observation/refinement bridge proof pending; this is an explicit candidate argument, not a checked theorem.

observation.public: Numerical equality or both NaN; payload and zero-sign may be unobserved by the public spec.
observation.native_stronger_checks: Independent oracle checks exact non-NaN bits, including sign of zero, and both-NaN relation. Primitive controls additionally check NaN bit preservation, Arm propagation and RVV canonicalization.

oracle.implementation: Separate scalar harness: finite product exactly in binary64 then rounded once to binary32; no use of either runtime multiplication helper.
oracle.independence_limit: Shares host IEEE floating arithmetic, compiler and platform with the runtime; finite testing cannot establish universal correctness.

memory.input: n+3 readable float elements, allowing original NEON full tail loads. Exactly n+3 allocated in sanitizer harness. Input and padding snapshots checked unchanged.
memory.output: n writable active floats per side with separately checked prefix/suffix canaries; RVV primitive checks every vl=0..32 and unchanged inactive store frame.
memory.params: Separate readable slope parameter, all binary32 bit patterns permitted, unchanged snapshot checked.
memory.aliasing: Inputs, both outputs and params occupy separate objects; no overlapping or in-place execution claim.

primitives.name: vdupq_n_f32
primitives.semantics: Replicate unchanged binary32 representation into four lanes.

primitives.name: vmovq_n_s32
primitives.semantics: Replicate signed int32 into four lanes.

primitives.name: vld1q_f32
primitives.semantics: Read exactly four consecutive float representations, including NaN payload/sign and signed zero.

primitives.name: vmulq_f32
primitives.semantics: Four independent IEEE binary32 RNE products; Arm DN=0/FZ=0 NaN selection, signaling operands before quiet operands and then operand order; invalid zero-times-infinity gives positive default quiet NaN.

primitives.name: vreinterpretq_s32_f32
primitives.semantics: Preserve all 128 bits; reinterpret each binary32 lane as signed two-complement int32.

primitives.name: vcltq_s32
primitives.semantics: Signed integer comparison; true lane is 0xffffffff, false is zero. Comparing the reinterpreted input with zero tests its original sign bit, including negative zero and negative NaNs.

primitives.name: vbslq_f32
primitives.semantics: Per-bit (mask & first) | (~mask & second); true sign mask selects product, false selects original input; no float conversion.

primitives.name: vst1q_f32
primitives.semantics: Write exactly four unchanged lane representations.

primitives.name: vst1_f32
primitives.semantics: Write exactly two unchanged lane representations.

primitives.name: vst1_lane_f32
primitives.semantics: Write exactly the requested single lane; this kernel requests lane zero.

primitives.name: __riscv_vsetvl_e32m8
primitives.semantics: Fixed VLEN128/SEW32/LMUL8: VLMAX32. Choose min(AVL,32), a permitted implementation choice; other permitted choices in AVL 33..63 are not tested.

primitives.name: __riscv_vle32_v_f32m8
primitives.semantics: Read exactly vl consecutive float representations. Tail-agnostic inactive destination lanes explicitly use all-one bits.

primitives.name: __riscv_vfmul_vf_f32m8
primitives.semantics: Multiply active lanes only using binary32 RNE with gradual underflow; all arithmetic NaN results are canonical 0x7fc00000. Tail-agnostic lanes use all-one bits.

primitives.name: __riscv_vreinterpret_v_f32m8_i32m8
primitives.semantics: Preserve every source representation, including original sign, NaN payload, signed zero, and tail bits.

primitives.name: __riscv_vmslt_vx_i32m8_b4
primitives.semantics: Active signed int32 comparison; comparison with zero reads the original input sign bit. Mask tail lanes take the permitted all-ones choice.

primitives.name: __riscv_vmerge_vvm_f32m8
primitives.semantics: For every active body lane mask true chooses the second input (product), false chooses first (input); tail destination all ones.

primitives.name: __riscv_vse32_v_f32m8
primitives.semantics: Write exactly vl active lanes; memory outside the active range is untouched.

validation_design.values: 24 boundary/NaN/zero/Inf/subnormal patterns crossed against all 24 slopes, deterministic random raw bits and random slopes
controls: Valid-input output corruption rejected by independent oracle
Wrong sign-selection model on BOTH sides rejected by independent scalar oracle despite mutual agreement
Valid-C source-comment mutation rejected for each original implementation
validation_design.entry: spec.c equivalent plus direct calls to the two original impl files

proof_status: All primitives runtime-only; complete kernel QCP proof and formal runtime correspondence pending.
